description: This file defines a Discord outbound adapter for a messaging system, including functions for handling payload normalization, target resolution, webhook messaging, and sending messages/media/polls via Discord.

methods.name: hasApprovalChannelData
methods.description: Checks if the payload contains approval channel data.

methods.name: neutralizeDiscordApprovalMentions
methods.description: Replaces @everyone, @here, and user/channel mentions with neutralized versions to prevent unwanted notifications.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordApprovalPayload
methods.description: Normalizes payload by neutralizing approval mentions if approval channel data is present.

methods.name: resolveDiscordOutboundTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target string for Discord messages, considering thread IDs.

methods.name: resolveDiscordWebhookIdentity
methods.description: Resolves username and avatar URL for Discord webhook identity based on provided identity and binding info.

methods.name: maybeSendDiscordWebhookText
methods.description: Sends a Discord webhook message if webhook info is available for the thread.
